Container.Name: series-ripper
Container.Overview: Rips TV series from DVD, Blu-ray and 4K UHD discs with MakeMKV and names the episodes for Plex/Jellyfin (Show/Season 1/Show - S01E01.mkv). Web UI with one card per drive: scan a disc, check the proposed episode numbers and rip - or switch a drive to Automatic Mode and just feed it discs. Several drives can rip at the same time, each into its own show. Detects "Play All" titles, menus and extras and parks anything it isn't sure about in a review queue. Show profiles, rip history, Discord/ntfy/Gotify notifications, fetches MakeMKV's free beta key automatically. 4K UHD needs a LibreDrive-compatible drive.
Container.Requires: An optical drive (USB is fine) passed through as its SCSI generic device. Find it in the Unraid terminal with: lsscsi -g (the last two columns of the optical drive's line are its /dev/srN and /dev/sgN). The drive must be connected when the container starts. More drives: click "Add another Path, Port, Variable, Label or Device", choose Device, and add each extra drive's /dev/sgN and /dev/srN the same way.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Settings, shows, history, review queue and MakeMKV's own data (license key, LibreDrive data).

Config.Name: TV library
Config.Description: Folder that holds your TV shows. Episodes go to Show Name/Season 1/. Unless Temp is set below, half-finished rips are kept in a hidden .series-ripper-tmp folder here (never in docker.img - a 4K UHD title can be 50+ GB).

Config.Name: Temp (optional)
Config.Description: Optional separate folder for rips in progress, e.g. a folder on a cache-only share. Leave empty to use the TV library share (recommended: the final move is then an instant rename instead of a copy).

Config.Name: Optical drive - SCSI generic device
Config.Description: REQUIRED - MakeMKV finds drives through this one. The /dev/sgN from 'lsscsi -g' for your optical drive, e.g. /dev/sg5. USB drives can get a new number after being unplugged; update it here if the container won't start.

Config.Name: Optical drive - block device
Config.Description: The /dev/srN from 'lsscsi -g'. Used for instant disc detection (without it the app has to ask MakeMKV every few seconds) and for ejecting.

Config.Name: MakeMKV key
Config.Description: BETA = fetch MakeMKV's free beta key from the MakeMKV forum automatically (re-checked daily, the key changes about monthly). Or paste your purchased key (T-...).

Config.Name: Web UI password (optional)
Config.Description: If set, the web UI asks for this password (any user name). Leave empty for no password - then keep the port on your LAN only.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of ripped files (99 = nobody, the Unraid default).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permission mask for ripped files and folders.
